pairingFeedback.message: Balanced plate: lean protein + green veg + whole grain.

recipe.title: Lemon Garlic Oven Salmon with Asparagus and Brown Rice
recipe.summary: Weeknight healthy meal with crisp-tender asparagus and flaky salmon.

steps.instruction: Start rice per package (usually 1 cup rice + 2 cups water).
steps.techniqueTip: Rinse rice until water runs less cloudy for better texture.

steps.instruction: Heat oven to 425°F. Place salmon and asparagus on a sheet pan.
Mix olive oil, garlic, lemon zest, half the lemon juice, salt, and pepper. Brush over salmon and asparagus.
steps.techniqueTip: Coat asparagus lightly so it roasts instead of steams.

steps.instruction: Bake 12–14 minutes until salmon flakes and asparagus is tender-crisp.
steps.techniqueTip: Pull salmon at 125–130°F internal for moist results.

steps.instruction: Fluff rice, plate everything, finish with remaining lemon juice.

substitutions.impact: Similar cook time, slightly milder flavor.
Cooks faster and has a nuttier taste.

commonMistakes.fix: Check at minute 12; remove when center is just opaque.
Use high heat and avoid overcrowding pan.

pairingFeedback.message: Comfort-forward with one lighter green side for balance.

recipe.title: Crispy Air-Fryer Chicken Thighs with Mac and Cheese + Green Beans
recipe.summary: Comfort meal with crisp skin and quick stovetop sides.

steps.instruction: Preheat air fryer to 390°F. Pat chicken dry; season with salt, pepper, paprika, and garlic powder.
Air-fry chicken skin-side down 12 min, flip, then 10–12 min until 175°F internal.
steps.techniqueTip: Do not crowd basket; cook in batches if needed.

steps.instruction: Boil pasta until al dente. Drain.
In pot, melt butter, add milk, warm gently, then stir in cheddar until smooth. Toss pasta in sauce.
steps.techniqueTip: Keep heat low to avoid grainy cheese sauce.

steps.instruction: Sauté green beans with a little oil and pinch of salt until bright and tender-crisp.

substitutions.impact: Cook faster; reduce second phase by ~3 min.

commonMistakes.fix: Use low heat and add cheese gradually.

pairingFeedback.message: Excellent texture contrast and spicy-friendly structure.

recipe.title: Spicy Crispy Tofu Bowl with Bok Choy and Rice
recipe.summary: Fast stovetop bowl with chili-garlic glaze and crunchy edges.

steps.instruction: Toss tofu cubes with cornstarch and a pinch of salt.
Pan-fry tofu in oil over medium-high heat 8–10 minutes until golden on most sides.
steps.techniqueTip: Let cubes sit before flipping for better crust.

steps.instruction: Whisk soy sauce, chili garlic sauce, honey/maple, rice vinegar, and garlic. Add to pan and toss 1–2 minutes.
steps.techniqueTip: Sauce thickens fast; lower heat once glossy.

steps.instruction: In a second pan, stir-fry bok choy with a little oil and salt until just wilted.
Serve tofu over rice with bok choy.

commonMistakes.fix: Press tofu and avoid moving too often while searing.
Add glaze at end and reduce heat immediately.
